## Content checklist (for page changes)

- [ ] Matches the **structure** — correct path and slug; new pages exist as topics in Library-Structure
- [ ] Offensive pages are **exploitation + explanation only** — no detection, mitigation, or remediation (that lives in the defensive section)
- [ ] Each page keeps a `> **Scope.**` authorized-testing note
- [ ] No `## See also` section (the website handles cross-linking)
- [ ] Frontmatter (`title`, `description`, `keywords`) aligned with the body; American English
- [ ] Payloads and examples are accurate and runnable
- [ ] This PR targets `dev` (not `main`)
